{"consolidated_memory":"COMPONENT: billing/invoice_totals.py (billing side)
RECURRING ISSUE: Off-by-one cent in the totals calculator, manifesting as one cent gaps in reconciliation reports.
REPRODUCTION: Total an invoice with three prorated lines.
TEST COVERAGE: tests/billing/test_invoice_totals.py

THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS WITH DIFFERENT ROOT CAUSES:

OCCASION 1 - [2026-03-15]
Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
Root Cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
PR/Branch: PR #1082, branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1
Outcome: Flaky test went from 61 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 2 - [2026-04-12]
Trigger: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root Cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
Fix: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
PR/Branch: PR #4174, branch fix/off-by-one-cent-2
Outcome: Backlog cleared 8 minutes after the deploy

OCCASION 3 - [2026-07-22]
Trigger: Two requests raced on the same key
Root Cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
PR/Branch: PR #9811, branch fix/off-by-one-cent-3
Outcome: 39 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

Stack: Python"}
